summary: Comparison helper that compares two indirect __int16 string pointers against a shared reference string stored in the global context pointer (dword_8D46B4 + 128) using StringComparisonWithConstantDispatch, then subtracts the two per-string results to produce an ordering result. When the sort-direction flag at (dword_8D46B4 + 132) is zero the result is negated, giving reverse sort order.

operations.description: Dereference the first indirect string pointer: v2 = *a1, where the string pointer is read from the memory the caller's pointer addresses (this+0).
Compare the second indirect string *a2 against the context reference string at (dword_8D46B4 + 128): v3 = StringComparisonWithConstantDispatch(*a2, *(const char**)(dword_8D46B4 + 128), 0).

Compare the first indirect string v2 against the same context reference string and subtract the second result: result = StringComparisonWithConstantDispatch(v2, *(const char**)(dword_8D46B4 + 128), 0) - v3.
When the direction flag at (dword_8D46B4 + 132) is zero, return the negated result (-result) for reverse sort order; otherwise fall through to the direct return.
Return the computed difference: -result when the direction flag is zero, otherwise result as-is.
